page.overview:
Who is Aralosaurus?

is an extinct genus of hadrosaurid dinosaur that lived in Kazakhstan during the Late Cretaceous period. It's name comes from the fact that its fossils were found in the northeast of the Aral Sea. Aralosaurus was found in the Bostobe Formation alongside and many unnamed dinosaurs. It also has its own clade: the Aralosaurini.

Aralosaurus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia section of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. Its image can be found within the files, which may indicate that it would almost get one. However, it would receive a profile in the website Dinosaur Earth on Dinopedia.
